root.help:
one — workspace development

USAGE
  one <command> [options]

EVERYDAY COMMANDS
  create        Create a workspace
  add           Add a project
  run           List and execute workspace tasks
  exec          Execute a command with project variables
  env           Manage environment variables
  login         Sign in to Infisical in your browser

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output  Output format: json | yaml | text
  -h, --help    Show help
  -v, --version Show version

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one add
  one dev
  one build -p web
  one test -p web

All commands: one help --all
Task shorthand: one <task> = one run <task> (built-ins take precedence)
Command help: one <command> --help

env.bind.tip:
Sign in with one login.

Run one env bind to select an existing project or create a workspace project interactively. Use --create to explicitly create and bind storage, or --project-id to bind an existing Secret Manager project. Existing bindings are preserved. Workspace bindings are saved to one.manifest.toml, with default environment dev. Without a binding, set fails instead of creating a project.

Run one env bind --global to initialize shared credential storage. Without a saved binding, creates or reuses shared-credentials with default environment dev. No project selection or ID is required. Existing bindings are preserved; --env changes the default environment. Shared credential binding metadata is saved in local configuration.

locale.tip:
Shows the saved language preference and the language active in this terminal. Pass auto, zh-CN, or en-US to change the preference.

auto follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG; the fallback is English. The Dashboard shares this preference. Project and third-party tool logs keep their original language.
exec.tip:
Runs a command in the selected project directory. Select a project by name or relative path, or run from inside a project. The positional project and --project must agree when both are used.

Use -- to separate One options from the child command. When the workspace has an env.infisical binding, variables are fetched from Infisical and injected into the child process. --env selects the environment. Injected values override same-name shell variables. Without a binding, the shell environment is used directly. Local .env files are not loaded by One.

With --global, provide --env and --path explicitly. The command keeps the current working directory. Use --keys to select shared credentials.

One does not print injected variable values. Child stdout and stderr pass through unchanged.
serve.tip:
Starts a local Dashboard for workspaces, development services, project configuration, Infisical login, and shared credentials. The project Run tab provides start, stop, restart, a live console, and local access links. Review manifest changes before saving. Plaintext variables are fetched only when viewed or copied.

By default, binds to 127.0.0.1 on an available port and opens your browser. Closing the page keeps services running; Ctrl-C stops the Dashboard and its services. Host and Origin checks protect the interface.

upgrade.short: Update One CLI to the latest stable release
upgrade.long:
Check for the latest stable One CLI release and update the current executable.
Downloads are verified with SHA256 and a version check. An equal or newer
installed version is kept.

Manual updates check immediately, including in CI and JSON/YAML output.
Only official stable release builds can upgrade. On Windows, the verified
update is installed after this command exits.
